slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第25章大魔导师的弟子
在罗兰侯爵的城堡内，一位穿着星空色长袍的美妇人跟罗兰夫人手挽着手走去了辛西娅·罗兰的房间。
与辛西娅离开前不同，乱糟糟的房间已经被收拾干净了，卫生上一尘不染，书架上也……干干净净。
“我亲爱的弗兰卡·罗西，拜托你找找我那不成器的女儿吧。”罗兰夫人向旁边那位美妇人投去了恳求的眼神。
名为弗兰卡·罗西的美妇人轻轻拨开垂下来的绸缎红发，紧紧握住了罗兰夫人的手，并在手背上轻拍两下。
“我尊贵的夫人，你已经很久没有喊过我的全名了，看来辛西娅的事情已经让你慌到焦头烂额了。”弗兰卡微微笑着，“别担心，我会找到她的。”
“我的大魔导师啊，快找找辛西娅的下落吧。”罗兰侯爵也情绪激动地看向了弗兰卡，若不是现在的身份不合适，这位侯爵大人也不知道会露出怎样的丑态。
“好了好了我的老朋友，难得你们夫妻俩有求于我，作为罗兰家族的客卿，无论于公、私、情理，我都会尽全力的。”弗兰卡轻松笑道。
在见到这一抹自信的笑容后，侯爵夫妇都安心了许多。
“全世界鼎鼎大名的大魔导师——弗兰卡·罗西，有你在，我们便安心了。”罗兰侯爵夸奖着弗兰卡，却引得对方轻笑。
“这么多年过去，你们也是一点没变啊……”弗兰卡·罗西挥挥手，手中突然出现一根魔杖。
她将魔杖往前一丢，正好落到了房间的正中央。刹那间，庞大的魔力汇聚而来，将整个房间染成了星空色。
四面光华流过，弗兰卡开始聚精会神的捕捉着那些流光。可忽然间，她惊讶地睁大了瞳孔，露出了不可置信的神色。
眉头微皱，她收了魔法，做出了一副严肃的沉思状。
看她神情严肃，罗兰夫妇慌了。
“弗兰卡，我亲爱的弗兰卡，辛西娅是遇到危险了吗？”
“我的老朋友啊，我不能失去辛西娅啊！”
两人一前一后围在了弗兰卡的身边，紧张兮兮的看着她。
“不，你们误会了。”弗兰卡摇头，随后认真地看着二人，“我只是发现我今后的生活质量会大幅度下滑，所以在思考晚上要吃什么。”
闻言，夫妻俩如释重负。
“你就是人前正经，在老朋友面前就原形毕露了……”罗兰夫人安心一笑，“既然你还有心说这些，就说明辛西娅没事，快跟我说说她现在的情况吧。”
“辛西娅结交了两位朋友，现在跟着骑士走上了冒险的旅途，你不必担心她，亲爱的。”弗兰卡对罗兰夫人笑道。
罗兰侯爵在听到这个消息后大喜，急促道：“弗兰卡，那就快把辛西娅带回来吧，以你的手段用不了多少分钟的！”
“等等，让她回来做什么？”这一刻，罗兰夫人忽然开始跟丈夫唱反调了。
一时间，罗兰侯爵与弗兰卡都向她投去了困惑的目光。
“她不是找了个骑士朋友吗？想学骑士去冒险，没苦硬吃，那就让她好好尝尝苦头，到时候她就回来了。”说话间，这位前一刻还在担心女儿的女士露出了气愤的表情。
“可是……”罗兰侯爵还想说些什么，却被妻子打断了。

Chapter 25 Disciples of the Great Magister
In the castle of Marquis Roland, a beautiful woman wearing a starry sky-colored robe walked hand in hand with Mrs. Roland to Cynthia Roland's room.
Unlike before Cynthia left, the messy room has been tidied up, the hygiene is spotless, and the bookshelf is also... clean.
"My dear Franka Rossi, please look for my useless daughter." Mrs. Roland cast a pleading look at the beautiful woman next to her.
The beautiful woman named Franka Rossi gently brushed aside her hanging satin red hair, held Mrs. Roland's hand tightly, and patted the back of her hand twice.
"My noble lady, you haven't called me by my full name for a long time. It seems that Cynthia's matter has made you panic." Franka smiled slightly, "Don't worry, I will find her."
"My great mage, please find the whereabouts of Cynthia." Marquis Roland also looked at Franke emotionally. If his current identity was not inappropriate, he would not know what kind of ugly appearance the Marquis would show.
"Okay, okay, my old friend, it's rare that you and your wife ask for anything from me. As a guest of the Roland family, I will do my best regardless of business, personal, or emotional issues." Franka said with a relaxed smile.
After seeing this confident smile, the Marquis and his wife felt much relieved.
"Franca Rossi, the most famous magister in the world, we feel at ease with you." Marquis Roland praised Franka, but he made the other party chuckle.
"After all these years, you haven't changed at all..." Franka Rossi waved his hand, and a magic wand suddenly appeared in his hand.
She threw her wand forward and landed it right in the center of the room. In an instant, huge magic power gathered, dyeing the entire room the color of the starry sky.
Brilliance flowed from all sides, and Franke began to concentrate on capturing those streams of light. But suddenly, her pupils widened in surprise, showing an expression of disbelief.
Frowning slightly, she withdrew her magic and looked serious in contemplation.
Seeing her serious expression, the Roland couple panicked.
"Franke, my dear Franke, is Cynthia in danger?"
"My old friend, I can't lose Cynthia!"
The two of them gathered around Franka one after another, looking at her nervously.
"No, you misunderstood." Franke shook his head, then looked at the two of them seriously, "I just found that my quality of life will decline significantly in the future, so I am thinking about what to eat at night."
Hearing this, the couple felt relieved.
"You are so serious in front of others, but you show your true colors in front of old friends..." Mrs. Roland smiled reassuringly, "Since you still have the heart to say this, it means that Cynthia is fine. Tell me about her current situation."
"Cynthia has made two friends and is now following the knight on an adventurous journey. You don't have to worry about her, dear." Franka smiled at Mrs. Roland.
Marquis Roland was overjoyed after hearing the news and said hurriedly: "Franka, bring Cynthia back quickly. It won't take many minutes with your methods!"
"Wait, why do you want her to come back?" At this moment, Mrs. Roland suddenly began to contradict her husband.
For a moment, both Marquis Roland and Franke cast confused glances at her.
"Didn't she find a knight friend? If she wants to learn to be a knight and take risks without having to suffer, then let her taste the pain and she will come back." As she spoke, the lady who was worried about her daughter a moment ago showed an angry expression.
"But..." Marquis Roland wanted to say something more, but was interrupted by his wife.
